applies_to: Every generated or edited symbol, in every collection
required_views: Visual: individually inspect every profile at1024. Inspect64 only when fine detail, crowded layouts, contrast doubt or a relevant repair warrants it; record the per-symbol/profile decision and reason. Use128 only to resolve a doubt, with a reason. Tactile: individually inspect each full-detail profile, normally1024, plus exact nominal physical-scale design checks; tiny previews optional.
passes: Anatomy, required visible body parts and pose
Hands, joints, object contact, armpits and occlusion
Overlapping strokes, dark wedges, gaps and stray marks
Small-size clarity, contrast and consistent style
No visible text, decorative shading, shadows or unnecessary ground lines
Verify editable semantic regions already tagged during SVG creation
repair: Immutable versioned candidate; repeat1024 for every affected visual profile. Reassess64 and require it for repairs relevant to small-size clarity. Tactile repeats full-detail and physical-scale checks.
evidence: One review record per concept and candidate version, with source and rendered-proof hashes and specific written observations.
gate: Every symbol in a batch must pass its applicable recorded review plan before adoption or the next generation batch.
source_changes: Any change to the SVG invalidates the hash-bound visual review; review the new version.
meaning_limit: Assistant visual review is a design check, not evidence that intended users recognise the concept.
other_evaluations: Individual CVI assessment and physical tactile-reader testing remain separate required evidence for those suitability claims.
tagging_stage: Authorship: attach stable IDs, data-part and applicable data-person while drawing each region. The later semantic-region check verifies existing tags and never postpones tagging.
human_authority: 25 October2026: human agreed to1024 per visual profile with64 only for fine details,crowded layouts,contrast doubts or relevant repairs. Human asked whether512 would help;512 has not been authorised as a replacement.

tactile_review.not_physical_testing: NominalSVG dimensions and geometry only. Hardware calibration,actual printed tactile proofreading andlearner evaluation remainpending.

historical_evidence: Preserve version1 three-size and version2 two-size evidence unchanged. Review records bind their own immutable policy snapshot.

small_size_review_decision.format: Per symbol/profile: required boolean and a specific reason. If required, actually open64 and bind its proof. If omitted, explicitly state no64 inspection or small-size validation claimed.

base_size_512_status: Timing comparison only; not adopted as a review size.
